property_summary: Whenever transfer does not revert, it must return true; the mutant can return false on successful execution.
For any non‑reverting call to transfer, the return value must equal the truth of all internal calls succeeding; the buggy version always returns false regardless of success.
For every input where the external calls do not revert, transfer must return true; the mutant returns false for the same successful execution.
For any input where the external call loop does not revert, transfer must return true; the mutant returns false on the same non-reverting execution.
For any admissible input where transfer does not revert, the return value must be true; the buggy version returns false despite successful execution.
